title: A $p$-step generalization of the Q-order of convergence
summary: The notion of Q-order convergence is arguably the most important tool for describing the asymptotic behavior of a convergent sequence. Loosely speaking, it captures the``speed''of convergence of an iterative method. The concept of Q-order convergence is not always well suited for sequences whose errors do not decrease monotonically at every step. In this paper, we introduce the notion of $p$-step Q-order convergence.
